Hello, I would like you to draw, Wrenn.

She appears youthful, like a young adult, but her real origins and age are known only to a few. She takes care to maintain her appearance and presentation, and possesses a great wardrobe of clothing in various styles which she treasures.
Outwardly she is cordial and easy to approach, and possesses an almost supernatural charisma that allows her to charm almost anyone she encounters. She has a periodical craving for physical & emotional intimacy that must be satisfied, and those who can truly get through to her are hard to find indeed. 
Often insightful when it comes to matters of interpersonal relationships and emotions(and occult magics), she actually struggles with finding fulfilling relationships herself. Her rifle serves as both a bludgeoning weapon and a magical amplifier, leading her to develop a particularly brutal fighting style.

I will leave the other details to you.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
